brief:
Israeli forces carried out bombing, gunfire, and demolition operations across multiple areas of the Gaza Strip on Friday morning, Shehab Wire reported. The operations coincided with the use of illumination flares and resulted in casualties, according to emergency and ambulance services.

The full scale of casualties remained unclear as rescue services continued to respond to the incidents across the territory.

title: Israeli forces conduct bombing and demolition operations across Gaza Strip
